crossRefs.note: Yahweh saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man’s heart…
The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
As it was in the days of Noah, even so will it be also in the days of the Son of Man.
They ate, they drank, they married, and they were given in marriage until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and…

translations.web: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,
translations.bsb: Will you stay on the ancient path that wicked men have trod?
translations.kjv: Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?
translations.asv: Wilt thou keep the old way Which wicked men have trodden?
